items.plain: Attackers who can reach a VMware ESX host could take control of it without logging in - install the fixed ESX build now.
items.summary: VMware ESX contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the I/O filter service. Broadcom rated it Critical with a maximum CVSSv3 score of 9.8, and a network attacker can execute code on the host.

items.plain: Attackers who can reach a VMware ESX host could take control of it without logging in - install the fixed ESX build now.
items.summary: VMware ESX contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the I/O filter service. Broadcom rated it Critical with a maximum CVSSv3 score of 9.8, and a network attacker can execute code on the host.

items.plain: Attackers could read or replace files on systems running the BusyBox file service without logging in - update BusyBox and check if tftpd is on.
items.summary: BusyBox tftpd has an absolute path traversal vulnerability affecting versions through 1.38.0, rated CVSS 9.8 by NVD. An unauthenticated remote attacker can read or overwrite files on affected hosts.

items.plain: Attackers could corrupt or take over an exposed llama.cpp server without logging in - upgrade to the fixed build.
items.summary: llama.cpp contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ggml RPC server, rated CVSS 9.8. Unauthenticated attackers can write to arbitrary heap addresses via zero-element destination tensors; a fix is available.

items.plain: Attackers could take over WordPress sites using the Ultimate Member plugin without logging in - update the plugin to 2.14.2 or later.
items.summary: The WordPress Ultimate Member plugin has a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability allowing object injection, rated CVSS 9.8. The issue affects Ultimate Member through 2.14.1; updating to at least 2.14.2 is the stated fix.
